import pandas as pd
import seaborn as sns
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import statsmodels.api as sm
from statsmodels.formula.api import ols

# Load the dataset
df = pd.read_csv('/data/invaded_niche_pathways.csv')

# Check the first few rows of the dataset
df.head()

# Perform an ANOVA to test for differences in 'n.gard' across 'habitat' types
model = ols('n.gard ~ C(habitat)', data=df).fit()
anova_table = sm.stats.anova_lm(model, typ=2)
anova_table

import pandas as pd
import scipy.stats as stats

# Load the dataset
df = pd.read_csv('/data/invaded_niche_pathways.csv')

# Group the data by 'habitat' and calculate the mean and standard deviation of 'n.gard'
grouped = df.groupby('habitat')['n.gard'].agg(['mean', 'std', 'count']).reset_index()
grouped

# Perform one-way ANOVA to test for differences in 'n.gard' across 'habitat' types
# Extract the 'n.gard' values for each 'habitat' group
groups = [df[df['habitat'] == habitat]['n.gard'] for habitat in df['habitat'].unique()]

# Perform the ANOVA
f_statistic, p_value = stats.f_oneway(*groups)
f_statistic, p_value
